selected_programme.selection_rule: Pareto/lexicographic: changes named decisions; addresses repeated blocker; no lower-cost existing-data route; shared-shot low marginal burden; removable-item necessity; lowest remaining cost/difficulty/non-identification risk
selected_programme.scope: local method, pairing, closure, tail, variance, and shot-context feasibility

mandatory_measurements.necessity: removal prevents separation of total assayable content from method-conditioned I_ref and calculation of f_ref with covariance
removal eliminates the operational input inventory and endpoint evidence
removal prevents absolute cup closure and species-trajectory comparison
removal leaves collector/fraction transfer loss and mass-boundary integrity untestable
removal omits the principal post-shot residual term and makes closure incomplete
removal forces an unobserved term toward implicit zero and invalidates closure
removal makes initial and residual quantities basis-incommensurate
removal requires invented or commanded pressure as achieved boundary
removal prevents synchronized chemistry observation and shot clock
removal leaves operating state and shot comparability uncontrolled
removal breaks joins among lot, aliquot, shot, fraction, spent puck, preparation, injection, and batch

optional_measurements.condition: only if detection location, definition, latency, and uncertainty qualify
mandatory when declared closure locations require it

stage_f.name: METHOD_TAIL_RECOVERY_PAIRING_MASS_CLOSURE_VARIANCE_FEASIBILITY
stage_f.design: one principal contrast at a time; randomized or balanced independent-shot order; operator/day and analytical-batch blocks; all exclusions retained
stage_f.sequential_rule: Collect and retain every sequential fraction through the operator-declared feasible cycle limit. No SCI-ED-002 1%/two-consecutive/eight-cycle rule is adopted. Analyze caffeine and trigonelline separately. If quantified or material tail persists at the feasible maximum, return MAXIMUM_FEASIBLE_CYCLE_REACHED_ENDPOINT_NOT_QUALIFIED; do not extrapolate it to zero.
stage_f.freeze_use: Stage F may inform a later freeze but is development data and cannot itself be relabeled as protected validation

stage_d.name: LATER_DECISION_CAPABLE_PROGRAMME
stage_d.sample_size_derivation: Before observations are opened, calculate independent-shot and preparation counts from Stage F variance components, named effect measure/materiality, interval coverage and chosen precision/power/assurance, block structure, multiplicity if applicable, expected qualification loss, maximum feasible resources, and sequential no-decision/error control. Technical replicates do not increase independent-shot n.
stage_d.endpoint_freeze: analyte/matrix-specific omission or tail uncertainty must be small enough relative to the named EWP decision threshold; exact rule frozen prospectively
stage_d.sequential_stop: stop only under prospectively error-controlled acceptance, rejection, futility/no-decision, safety/capability, or maximum-count rules; failure to attain precision is NO_DECISION, not forced selection
stage_d.holdout: any protected comparison requires its own G1/G3 freeze

technical_replicates: repeat analytical preparations quantify preparation variance

components: observation-operator/model contribution for inferred EWP quantities

estimand: decision-relevant analyte above LOQ or censoring modeled
qualification_gates.model_decision: separate positive/negative/null/blocked regions from DECISION_ESTIMAND_REGISTER.json; success is not agreement with EWP

materiality_derivation.rule: name EWP output/model choice, effect measure, current artifact inputs, empirical variance inputs, and threshold calculation; laboratory convenience alone is invalid

removable_item_proof: Each mandatory measurement names at least one decision lost on removal; removing any X01-X12 reduces decision coverage or invalidates an operator/qualification gate.

deferred_modules.reason: does not close current absolute-chemistry blocker and EWP bridges/incremental output materiality are unestablished
deferred_modules.trigger: prospective calculation shows phi_0/K_sat_eff uncertainty can change a named EWP output decision

deferred_modules.reason: fixed resistance is retained by parsimony and no distinguishing intervention/observable is yet qualified
deferred_modules.trigger: new synchronized materially separated conditions with lower non-identification risk
deferred_modules.later_task: hydraulic G2 proposal only if positive

deferred_modules.reason: local closure/operator qualification must precede sealed transfer
deferred_modules.trigger: qualified local method and separate prospective G1/G3 freeze
